verdict.rationale: Poly is a SaaS file platform with an official MCP endpoint and CLI, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The file-version history (Flashback, revisions) and beta release notes are a different feature and do not count toward API versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
